body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Round 1: 5 Cursor specialists + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings; all findings were pre-existing/OOS relative to the 4-line SKILL.md change.

Accepted: 0 | Rejected: 3 (all pre-existing/OOS)

## Rejected Code Review Findings
### [Code Review] Cursor-Security (round 1)
**Finding**: Committed `larch-logs/implement/EDBEF8E7-.../manifest.json` records `operator_cwd` and `operator_repo_root` as absolute paths, exposing username and clone path in git history.
**Reason not implemented**: This finding is about a pre-existing larch-log manifest behavior from a prior PR (EDBEF8E7), not introduced by this 4-line patch. Out of scope for this fix.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Security (round 1)
**Finding**: `--step-prefix` encoding has no rule forbidding `::` inside TEXT_PATH, leading to potential misparse.
**Reason not implemented**: This is about skills/shared/progress-reporting.md doc content from a prior PR, not our change. Pre-existing editorial issue.

### [Code Review] Generic-Codex (round 1)
**Finding**: `skills/shared/progress-reporting.md:157` nested skill-path formula inconsistency (`{PARENT_SKILL_PATH}:/{local_skill_name}` vs `/implement://design`).
**Reason not implemented**: Same pre-existing doc issue in progress-reporting.md from a prior PR, not introduced by our 4-line SKILL.md patch.
